name: Tori x Tori ~Ecchi Shite Kunnai to Itazura Shichau zo?~
original_name: とり×とり　～えっちしてくんないとイタズラしちゃうゾ？～
source:
The special product of this town is pumpkin.... Pumpkin and Halloween are used to liven up the town. Shunsuke's high school usually has a school festival at the end of October and his class plans to open a ghost house for the festival. There is an old house standing next to his apartment and it seems no one lives there. They decide to use this house as a ghost house. Shunsuke goes inside to look around and meets monsters.... He runs away but next day, a girl comes to his place with three followers. It seems that he met them before... actually, they are the ones he met at the old house! "We request for your cooperation!"

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
这座小镇的特产是南瓜……人们借助南瓜与万圣节为城镇营造热闹气氛。俊介所在的高中通常在十月底举办校园祭，他的班级计划开设鬼屋。俊介公寓旁有一栋老宅，看起来无人居住，于是大家决定把那里用作鬼屋。俊介进入宅邸勘察，却遇见了怪物……他仓皇逃走，可第二天，一名少女带着三名随从来到住处。俊介似乎曾见过她们……事实上，她们正是老宅里的那些人！‘请你协助我们！’

[摘自ErogeShop]
